name: Git merge
goalName: How do I solve a merge conflict when merging two branches in git?
goal: When working in a group, a repository is (almost) necessary for an effecient work flow. You and your teammates can create branches to get a clear view of what everyone is doing. When merging branches, however, merge conflicts can occur. I will conduct research on what merge conflicts are and how to resolve them.

result: Task failed succesfully! I got a merge conflict by editing the same file on seperate branches (without pushing) and merging those branches. I managed to fix it manually by editing the file, saving the resolved merge, and pushing it to the repository. For a bigger / more chaotic file like a scene from Unity, it will require more effort, but that will be researched in another entry.<<image 1.png>>
validation: I validated my work with a teacher, who said the thinkering was performed excellent.
contribution: Now I got an understanding on how to solve merge conflicts, I will create a Unity project and create a git repository for a test project. Furthermore, I will discuss a git branching strategy with my teammates.
